channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — New KEVs
channel.description: Vulnerabilities newly appearing in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

item.title: CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) contain an incorrect use of privileged APIs vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

item.title: CVE-2026-58704 — Google Pixel
item.description: Threat Signal 65. Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.
